rules.name: ouat178-bu-mapping-gap
rules.sql: SELECT v.tenant_id, v.business_unit, v.value_date, v.settlement_date, (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.correl_product_mapping m WHERE m.tenant_id = v.tenant_id AND m.business_unit = v.business_unit) AS mapping_rows, (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.security_info_table s WHERE s.tenant_id = v.tenant_id AND s.business_unit = v.business_unit AND s.derivative_type LIKE 'cs_spread%') AS spread_securities, (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.security_info_table s WHERE s.tenant_id = v.tenant_id AND s.business_unit = v.business_unit AND s.security_id LIKE 'CM WP%') AS wp_securities FROM opera.valuation_date_table v ORDER BY v.business_unit

SELECT business_unit, product_code, derivative_type, status, count(*) AS securities, min(maturity_date) AS min_maturity, max(maturity_date) AS max_maturity FROM opera.security_info_table WHERE derivative_type LIKE 'cs_spread%' AND product_code IN ('CM WP', 'CM KP', 'CM KX', 'CM WY') GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4 ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4

SELECT TRIM(product_code) AS product_code, TRIM(primary_code) AS primary_code, TRIM(secondary_code) AS secondary_code, primary_multiplier, secondary_multiplier FROM dbsystemuat.correl_product_mapping_table ORDER BY product_code
